description: Eight independent backend static-quality signals under one owner with shared setup. Every command runs to completion so each gets its own sub-verdict; the runner then exits non-zero if any failed. Commands are relative to backend/, which is the runner's working directory. ruff (lint and format) and pyright also cover the repo-root tools/ and scripts/ Python: ruff through the explicit ../tools ../scripts paths with --config pyproject.toml (so files outside backend/ use backend's rules), pyright through backend/pyrightconfig.json include. scope_exclusions records what is deliberately outside that scope; run_checks.py reads only checks.

scope_exclusions.reason: frontend/eslint.config.mjs is a flat config whose base path is frontend/, so ESLint 9 ignores files outside it, and its Next/TypeScript rule set does not fit a standalone Node CommonJS script. A second ESLint config for one file is not proportionate.
Gitignored local load-test harness: untracked and absent from every CI checkout. Excluded (ruff extend-exclude, pyright exclude) so local runs match CI.
F-18 scope is lint, format and import resolution only. These checks stay on app agents tools.
